posts.hook: Apple's foldable finally ships, and an AI safety exodus hits the front pages
posts.caption: apple's foldable iphone duo ships at $1,999, an anthropic researcher quits warning ai labs are gambling with humanity's odds, and cognition's ai agents crack a 35 year old rsa factoring record. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo ships October 23
slides.desc: $1,999 to start, cheaper than expected during a memory shortage

slides.title: An Anthropic researcher quit warning AI could kill us all
slides.desc: Alignment lead agrees, puts extinction odds above ==10%== this decade

slides.title: A new OpenAI board member says risk isn't under control
slides.desc: Paul Christiano joins the safety committee he says needs to move faster

slides.title: AI agents just cracked a 35-year-old encryption record
slides.desc: Devin agents factored RSA-260 for ==10x less== than the old record cost

terms.gloss: a huge encryption number unbroken since 1991

slides.title: Four hacking groups share the same browser exploit kit
slides.desc: Chains Chrome and Windows bugs patched only in the last 24 hours

slides.title: WordPress's parent company sidelines its own CEO
slides.desc: Automattic's board placed Matt Mullenweg on leave over his objection

posts.hook: OpenAI and DeepSeek shipped rival flagships hours apart, and Meta's new AI got unnervingly good at your inbox
posts.caption: openai and deepseek both shipped new flagship models today, openai's math millennium prize claim keeps drawing academic pushback, and blizzard's new union contract limits how much microsoft can automate away. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI shipped its new flagship, GPT-6 Astra
slides.desc: Built for computer use, coding and business work, at $10/$50 per million tokens

slides.title: DeepSeek answered with V4.1-Flash the same day
slides.desc: 552B params, but beats its own flagship at ==a quarter== the memory cost

slides.title: OpenAI's math breakthrough keeps drawing scrutiny
slides.desc: Accused of racing to publish before the mathematicians it may have scooped

slides.title: A chip startup raised $875M to dodge the memory crunch
slides.desc: Positron's Asimov chip skips scarce HBM for ordinary laptop-grade memory

terms.gloss: the fast, scarce memory chips AI hardware fights over

slides.title: Bending Spoons is buying workplace tool Miro
slides.desc: All-cash deal values the collaboration platform at $1.36B

slides.title: Blizzard workers won a contract that limits AI automation
slides.desc: Microsoft can't automate their jobs away without union talks first

slides.title: Meta's new Muse AI works, and it's a little creepy
